==About==

{{i|Huckleberries}} can be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}} or {{i|Copper Pot}} for 3 hours to make {{i|Huckleberry Pectin}}. Huckleberry Pectin '''CANNOT''' be used for Gluttony.
